args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened and what I did:

**Situation:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1 across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated deployment history** — confirmed v2.3.1 was the failing deploy, and identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only ever in staging).
2. **Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0** — rollout succeeded to us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
3. **Verified recovery** — checkout-api is now healthy in all regions, with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident INC-0001 (SEV2)** describing the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer was paged.

**Recommended follow-up:** investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression before attempting another deploy.
